name: forum500-monorepo
description: Forum500 — NestJS API (backends/) + Next.js admin & member apps (frontends/). Each app installs, builds and deploys independently.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backends install && npm --prefix frontends/admin install && npm --prefix frontends/web install
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix backends run build && npm --prefix frontends/admin run build && npm --prefix frontends/web run build
